title.zh: 开普勒轨道 · 椭圆、速度与凌日
title.en: Kepler orbits · ellipses, speed and transits

description.zh: 行星沿椭圆绕恒星运行，恒星在一个焦点上；偏心率越大，椭圆越扁；离恒星近时跑得快、远时跑得慢（开普勒第二定律）；当轨道恰好侧对着我们，行星经过恒星前方会挡住一点星光，这就是凌日。
description.en: A planet travels round its star on an ellipse with the star at one focus; the larger the eccentricity, the flatter the ellipse; it moves fast when close to the star and slowly when far (Kepler’s second law); when the orbit is seen edge-on, the planet passing in front of the star blocks a little of its light — a transit.

aliases.zh: 行星为什么离太阳近时更快
aliases.en: why do planets move faster near the sun

label.en: Gravity produces the ellipse and the changing speed

reason.zh: 平方反比的引力让束缚轨道成为椭圆；靠近恒星时引力做正功、速度变大，远离时速度变小。
reason.en: An inverse-square pull makes bound orbits ellipses; falling closer, gravity speeds the planet up, and climbing away, it slows down.

label.en: An orbit is a conic section

reason.zh: 偏心率 e 把圆（e = 0）和越来越扁的椭圆（0 < e < 1）串成一族；恒星在椭圆的一个焦点上，不在中心。
reason.en: The eccentricity e strings together the circle (e = 0) and ever-flatter ellipses (0 < e < 1); the star sits at one focus of the ellipse, not at its centre.
